title: Sujetos nulos en coordinación
reviewer: Codex R33 local semantic source review

semanticReview.method: Inspección de estudio académico primario, ejemplo/pasaje o resumen público localizado; artículo corregido al alcance respaldado; APA 7, Evidence y assessEntry posterior ejecutados.
findings: McShane describes argument omission in Russian repetition structures when consecutive clauses repeat the same verb and arguments; this entry is limited to that configuration rather than claiming arbitrary null subjects in coordination.

Localizador: § 4.2.3, pp. 121–122, lines 973–994: consecutive conjuncts/clauses with the same verb and selected arguments form repetition structures; arguments are normally elided unless overt repetition has a stylistic purpose.
APA 7: McShane, M. (2009). Subject ellipsis in Russian and Polish. Studia Linguistica, 63(1), 98–132. https://homepages.hass.rpi.edu/mcsham2/MargePapers/McShane_Subject_2009.pdf
limitations: Se eliminaron generalizaciones fuera de la configuración investigada.
Se conservaron los enlaces de entradas relacionadas originales.
